entities.summary: Ludvig Hoff  is a Norwegian professional ice hockey player for the Stavanger Oilers of the GET-ligaen. He was born in Oslo and is the son of former Olympic athlete, Geir Hoff. He spent three seasons of college ice hockey with the North Dakota Fighting Hawks.
